# config: terminal: word jumping

Make ⌥← / ⌥→ jump by word in the terminal, and ⌘← / ⌘→ to line start/end, per the [iTerm2 recipe](https://coderwall.com/p/h6yfda/use-and-to-jump-forwards-backwards-words-in-iterm-2-on-os-x) (map the keys to the escape sequences `\eb`/`\ef` in the profile's key bindings). **Motivation:** editing long command lines without arrowing character by character.
